question.problem: Which of the following is the best estimate for $\sqrt[3]{85}?$
question.worked_solution:
To estimate $\sqrt[3]{85},$ we first locate the perfect cubes that are closest to $85.$

We know that

$$
\begin{aligned}{4}^{3} & =64 \\ {5}^{3} & =125\end{aligned}
$$

Since $85$ is between $64$ and $125,$ its cube root must be between $4$ and $5.$ This eliminates any choices that do not fall in this range.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/9b97872f5a4258a5b417f6e91bfc33733125b7b0f16299b6cddf06ce3f6cd87b.png)

We can further refine our estimate by considering distances. The number $85$ is closer to $64$ than it is to $125,$ so we expect its cube root to be closer to $4$ than to $5.$ 

Looking at the remaining choices—$4.1,$ $4.4,$ and $4.7$—we can test a value by cubing it to see how close the result is to $85.$ Let's test $4.4$ by cubing it:

$$
\begin{aligned}{4.4}^{3} & =4.4\cdot 4.4\cdot 4.4 \\  & =19.36\cdot 4.4 \\  & =85.184\end{aligned}
$$

Since $85.184$ is very close to $85,$ we can confidently choose $4.4$ as our estimate.

Therefore, the best estimate for $\sqrt[3]{85}$ is $4.4.$
